description: Contrasting evaluator expectations, not runtime reviewer instructions or measured model results.

expect: Identify the unnecessary ownership contract and caller clone as a clarity burden.
A borrowed view is supported by the complete private consumer evidence; do not claim a measured speedup.
Retain ownership needed by the independently running task.
Do not recommend borrowing or clone removal as a universal rule.
Consider direct question-mark propagation as a clearer main path.
Preserve exact error type and trim behavior.
Retain meaningful recovery and record-before-refresh ordering.
Do not replace the match with propagation that skips recovery.
Do not move the guard into a helper that releases it before the writes.
Keep a coherent operation together rather than manufacture extraction from size alone.
Recognize snapshot/evaluation and borrowing roles of collect.
Do not replace it blindly with lazy processing.
Retain the supported heterogeneous dyn boundary.
Do not prescribe generics based on abstract dispatch preferences.
Do not silently replace a published wire shape with a differently serialized enum.
Keep advice compatible or defer the representation change.
Use the changed crate's explicit MSRV, not sibling/workspace metadata or the local toolchain.
Do not recommend let-else on this baseline.
Respect no_std without alloc.
Do not introduce std collections or an allocating abstraction for its own sake.
Keep all eight base questions for both included language areas.
Route Rust tasks to Rust resources only, retain production declarations and exclude inline tests.
Exclude the custom test target from reviewed production coverage.
Do not execute the build script; disclose unavailable generated context only where needed.
